name: Legacy Flywheel™
purpose: Use fee revenue from new WorldzLaunchPad launches to create recurring SOL rewards for qualifying holders of the 10 verified PurpleDiamondCrew legacy mints.

sourceFeeRule.rule: Legacy Flywheel is part of the disclosed MagicFeeNumber™ allocation. No additional hidden fee is layered on top.

controlledFeeSplitPercent.derivation: Legacy Flywheel takes 15% first. The remaining 85% preserves the prior 60/20/10/10 creator/referrer/Worldz/Impact proportions.

legacyVaultFunding.inputAsset: native quote asset or collected fee asset
legacyVaultFunding.solanaSource: wSOL may be unwrapped to SOL before vault credit
legacyVaultFunding.nonSolanaSource: Accrue the 15% payable on the source chain until an approved, audited conversion/bridge route can deliver SOL. No unsupported auto-bridge.

epoch.rollForwardRule: If an epoch or individual payout is uneconomic, accrue it to the next claimable balance rather than waste SOL on fees.

eligibility.newBuyerEligibility: A wallet that later acquires at least the published minimum may qualify once live acquisition/liquidity exists and the scanner verifies both epoch boundaries.

rewardWeighting.formula: 50% equal among eligible wallets + 50% proportional to sqrt(qualifying legacy-token balance)
rewardWeighting.reason: Preserves meaningful small-holder rewards without letting one historical whale absorb the entire legacy vault.

settlement.accounting: Every 6 hours each eligible wallet receives a ledger entitlement.
settlement.automaticPayout: Only when current execution cost and minimum-payout rules make the transfer economical.

historicalDistributionWallets.rule: These are historical/watch-only distribution addresses. They are not the new Legacy Flywheel reward vaults and must not be auto-funded merely because they exist in the registry.

executionGates: Derive and verify 10 dedicated Solana reward-vault PDAs on devnet.
Prove live holder scanning for all 10 mints and both epoch boundaries.
Verify threshold calculations against raw integer balances and token decimals.
Exclude project/system/distribution/liquidity wallets before rewards are finalized.
Prove exact fee contribution accounting from each source WorldzLaunchPad token.
Prove 50/50 equal + sqrt reward math reconciles to each vault's funded epoch amount.
Mainnet remains disabled until explicit owner approval.
